title: Brawl Craft Order
intro: The eight Brawl decks that are not fully owned. The craft order ranks the unowned mythics and rares worth crafting across all of them; below it, each owned stand-in sits beside the craft it would replace. Ownership counts are lower bounds, so check before spending a wildcard.
